end.parentNote: Arjun practised comparing distances after converting them to the same unit. They used the method successfully in several examples, including 1 km 50 m = 1050 m and 2 km 750 m = 2750 m. They briefly chose 900 m over 1 km because 900 is the larger numeral, then corrected this by converting 1 km to 1000 m. At home, practise a few comparisons by writing every distance in metres before deciding which is longer.
